headline: US CFTC Convenes Regulatory Task Force on AI and Autonomous Financial Trading
summary: The Commodity Futures Trading Commission scheduled an October 28 task force meeting to examine how super intelligence technology and agentic AI impact financial and derivatives trading.
why: The CFTC regulates US futures and options markets, where algorithmic and autonomous AI trading systems increasingly dictate trading volume and market stability.

impacts.name: US Financial Exchanges
impacts.why: CFTC scrutiny could lead to new compliance and risk-monitoring requirements for algorithmic trading desks.
